**Session / topic:** Whittle estimation

## What I did
Coded Whittle estimation for an ARMA(1,1) and checked recovery on simulated data.

## What I learned
Parameters were poorly identified when the AR and MA terms nearly cancel, so I changed the true values.

## Difficulties and open questions
